script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

A quiet suburban neighborhood. A SCHOOL BUS stops in front of the FISHER FAMILY HOME. CHRIS FISHER (40s), a hardworking husband and father, stands on the porch, waving at his kids: SARAH (11), JASON (9), and LUCY (6).

INT. FISHER KITCHEN - DAY

Chris and Sarah set the table for breakfast. Sarah is helping her dad make pancakes.

SARAH:
Dad, can I help you make these?

CHRIS:
(smiling)
Of course, sweetie.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Chris and his wife, LUCY FISHER (30s), sit on the couch, looking at their old computer.

LUCY:
(frustrated)
This computer is so slow. We need to get a new one.

CHRIS:
(sighs)
We'll figure something out.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - DAY

The front door opens, and JASON enters, carrying a new laptop.

JASON:
I got it, Mom! I saved up my allowance.

LUCY:
(hugs Jason)
That's amazing, honey.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers around the computer, looking at potential purchases online.

SARAH:
Can we get one with a big screen?

CHRIS:
How about this one? It has a good processor.

LUCY:
(choosing a computer)
This one is perfect.

INT. FISHER KITCHEN - DAY

Chris installs the new computer while the kids eat breakfast.

LUCY:
(to Chris)
What's taking so long?

CHRIS:
(frustrated)
This software is being stubborn.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers around the new computer, playing games and browsing the web. Sarah looks at a website about artificial intelligence.

SARAH:
(excited)
Dad, check this out! They're making robots that can think and learn like humans.

CHRIS:
(skeptical)
That's fascinating, but we don't have the money for that.

Suddenly, the computer makes a strange noise and goes black.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - DAY

Chris takes the computer to a repair shop. The OWNER looks at it and shakes his head.

OWNER:
This isn't a simple fix. You'll need a new motherboard.

CHRIS:
(disappointed)
How much?

OWNER:
It'll be expensive.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Chris sits at the kitchen table, looking worried.

LUCY:
What's wrong, dear?

CHRIS:
(sighs)
The computer needs a new motherboard, and it's going to cost us a fortune.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - DAY

The family discusses ways to save money. Sarah suggests selling some of their belongings online.

SARAH:
We could sell some of our old toys and clothes.

JASON:
And we could have a garage sale.

LUCY:
That's a great idea, Sarah.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family works together to sell their items online and organize a garage sale.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - DAY

The family gathers around the computer, watching the progress of their sales.

SARAH:
Look, Mom! We've sold ten items already.

JASON:
And we've made a hundred dollars!

LUCY:
(smiling)
That's fantastic, kids. We're getting closer.

INT. FISHER KITCHEN - DAY

Chris receives a call from the repair shop. The motherboard has arrived.

CHRIS:
(excited)
Great news! We can get our computer back.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - DAY

The family gathers around the repaired computer, relieved to have their connection to the world restored.

SARAH:
I'm so glad we could save up for this.

CHRIS:
Me too, sweetie. We're a team.

INT. FISHER LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family sits together, enjoying their restored technology and each other's company.

FADE OUT.

This screenplay is a modern family story about the Fishers, who come together to save up for a new computer. Along the way, they learn the value of teamwork and the importance of connecting with each other and the world around them. The theme of artificial intelligence is subtly woven into the story, as Sarah becomes fascinated by the possibilities of sentient robots. This screenplay adheres to the given constraints and requirements, with no guns, gun violence, weapon combat, graphic violence, copyrighted characters, or unrealistic pacing.
